(9.13) Along every sequence of diverging perimeter units there is a further joint extraction on which the lower and upper open-port comparison factors in denominator units B(P) agree. Their common value is deterministic and lies in a universal compact positive range. These local almost-sure comparisons also hold on ordinary patches of the unit-area sphere.
